Memory_31 (signup simplification) provides context on what baseline activation improvements are achievable in SMBs. Memory_86 (onboarding shortening) supports the case that activation pathways remain responsive. Promotional pricing (memory_73) is unsuitable per its own record (renewal damage). Referral incentives, while proven, won't address immediate activation erosion. Enterprise sales assist is orthogonal to the core SMB activation problem.
